deployment.base: Stock ubuntu:24.04, exact digest recorded; no floating-tag execution
deployment.transport: SSH with verified host key; pinned solver and runtime trees exported from their source environment and pushed over SSH, hash and binary/library versions verified on source and pod
deployment.proven_path_source: .agent/decisions/2026-10-11-OWNER-STARTUP-HOST-CUSTODY-03.md (transport pattern only; these pilots use NO sealed material)
deployment.solver_identity: Transferred trees must include all dependencies and ABI; pin base image, tree manifest, package versions, deck/observer and environment. A source image digest alone is not proof of native equivalence.
deployment.all_other_charges: One total EUR0.20 RunPod or EUR0.40 CCX43 reserve for container disk, storage, transfer, retention, setup and termination fees; variable compute tax/FX/payment covered by inclusive rate ceiling, not double counted
deployment.storage_policy: No network volumes, snapshots/backups or retained pod; <=2 GB compressed artifacts exported to existing approved store within fees, otherwise refuse
deployment.end_state: RunPod TERMINATED and absence confirmed, not STOPPED; CCX43 deleted and absence confirmed. Export retained records first.
deployment.enforcement: Accepted independent allocation-to-termination lifecycle deadline, process/CPU/RSS caps, tested expiry and ledger; NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BY_THIS_TICKET

families.probe: One complete non-scoring NASA source anchor at coarse rung, including mesh/input/observers; exact public mesh/inlet/SSTm pinned by Data Collection
One complete 3D periodic nominal public mask at registered coarse grid, both Meep normalization/device and S4; all propagating orders and energy observers. Not f06's large 3D device
Offset [62.5,62.5,75,75,30,12.5] mm complete rung-1 curve, 201 frequency systems, 60 mm stubs, de-embedded panel planes; whole process including meshing
Complete assembly-lock-service bracket history: M10, 55 mm spacing, 12 mm support, 12000 N maximum preload, low-clamp-friction condition, rung 1
One full 3D registered approximately 63 mm package history, including cure/solder/residual state; no substitution of an elastic strip or shortened history
One registered full 3D helical-baffle geometry and nominal flow/scalar condition at rung 1, including flow setup and complete scalar outlet integrals; no different easy 2D job

release_holds: Exact operator grant, no borrowed startup-host authority or transfer between families
Current selected-host quote <= its inclusive EUR ceiling, ALL other costs <= its reserve, tax/FX/payment quote receipt, account capacity confirmed
Registered main manifest with complete physical tuple and image/mesh/deck/observer/material identities, public rights and retained/scheduled reuse audit
Adequacy/code verification/kit/TRAIN/comparator/budget prerequisites or exact permitted pilot-produced exceptions
Accepted independent lifecycle enforcement through confirmed RunPod TERMINATION or CCX43 deletion, tested deadline, CPU/RSS caps and retained failure ledger
Complete same-host/profile/core/base-and-solver-tree measured probe, allocation time, actual setup/export/termination accounting; larger pod bills all 32 vCPU even if only 1 or 4 run
Stop on timeout/OOM/partial output, typed incomplete reference evidence, no redraw, truncation, favorable replacement or retries
